quests.title: The Vanishing Bounty Target

dialogue.t: There's a particularly tricky bounty at The Flagship with basically no leads.
The target was attacking people in the north of Lempo Isle, but now he's disappeared without a trace. No one seems to know where he's gone...
Every contact leaves a trace. No matter how carefully someone covers their tracks, in doing so, they always create new ones.
Besides, just because the bounty didn't include any extra information, doesn't mean whoever posted it doesn't have any.
I never thought of that... I'll go ask Leszek — with all my experience, I should be able to get something useful out of him.
I'll leave it to you then.
You can count on me, Boss Nef!
Hmm... Seems like only yesterday, there were plenty of bounties going at The Flagship — now there's only one left.
Apparently, that's all down to {NICKNAME}. But even he(she) hasn't been able to crack this last one.
Well, there really aren't any leads—
Ah, but... Just because something isn't written on the bounty board, doesn't mean it doesn't exist.
What's this — a sudden flash of inspiration?
I'm going to ask Leszek — with all my experience, I should be able to get something useful out of him.
I'll leave it to you then.
You can count on me, Boss Nef!
Details on the targets are up on the board. I can fill you in if needed, but don't bother haggling over the bounties.
About the bounty targets...
There are four targets on the board, but we only have leads for three. The first one's wanted for fraud...
...Stop, stop, stop! Save me the spiel for the brand new treasure hunters — I could reel it off as well as you. You know who I'm here about.
The Curatorium wants to get involved?
That depends on how the Boss is feeling. Hmm, how did we arrive at you asking questions?
Anyway, seems to me the real reason Crackjaw's not been found is the lack of leads. Look at the board. You haven't even said what he looks like.

Well, if these treasure hunters set off without even knowing who they're looking for, well, they're hardly a match for someone like Hark. I don't want some novices wasting their time, much less throwing away their lives.
Fair point. Apart from the scar on his chin, what else can you tell me about him? Preferably something no one else knows?
Something no one else knows... You're looking for physical characteristics? Like, say, if he had some marks on his back?
That's exactly what I'm looking for! But how do you know so much about him?
I don't know squat. I never said he actually has any marks... Besides, even if he does, how are you going to see them?
W—Well, yeah, sorta... *sigh* So, there's nothing you can tell me? We've always worked well together — can't you give me anything to work with?
After Hark revealed his true nature here in Nasha Town, he fled to the north of Lempo Isle and picked up his old life of crime.
That's old news. Everyone and their dog knows that.
No one's reported seeing him recently. What if he went further north? I could maybe track him to Piramida, but what if he's made it all the way to Snezhnograd?
(Nothing but ice and snow up there. I'm not sure if my arm would function in the cold...)
He hasn't. He's still on Lempo Isle — I just don't know where. You can consider that "something no one else knows."
Huh, how can you be so certain?
Now that's a trade secret — you wanna know, you'll have to pay.
Hah, stingy! Still, a hulk of a man with a scar on his face... Even on Lempo Isle, they're not hard to find. How'm I supposed to know which one's Hark?
Well, seeing as how we "work together so well," I'll give you some free advice. Don't get too caught up in looking for a scar.
...Are you saying, he's found some way to hide the scar on his chin?
I guess that makes sense. If everyone knows you as Crackjaw, walking around with no visible scar on your face would be a pretty good way to hide...
In that case, I just need to find someone who's deliberately hiding their jawline, right? It's a lead, at least... Alright, if I find anything new, I'll come back and fill you in.
I'll wait with baited breath...

quests.description: On the bounty board at The Flagship, there’s a target known for vanishing without a trace after committing numerous heinous crimes. Yet justice demands retribution, and sins must be atoned for. Asking Leszek, an employee at The Flagship, may yield further information.
